entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for AI Agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that delivers memory, RAG, and user profiles via a single API. It features a custom vector graph engine and supports multi-modal extraction for PDFs, images, videos, and code.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that functions as an open-source context database using viking:// URIs. It employs tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for OpenClaw/Hermes Agents that creates typed edges for a self-wiring knowledge graph. It provides synthesized answers accompanied by citations and gap analysis.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and supports Docker-based deployment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that treats memory as a git repo using brv vc commit, branch, and merge versioning. It features an interactive TUI and REPL interface with 5-tier retrieval.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database without external services. It includes episodic compression and temporal knowledge graph capabilities.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It includes CLI tools for solving, simulating, and investigating tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin for Hermes Agent that uses a DAG-based context engine. It utilizes a SQLite message store with FTS metadata to build depth-aware summary nodes.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted Honcho memory backend designed for private cross-session persistence. It supports OpenAI-compatible LLM providers or local inference servers via Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that stores memory as plain-text YAML files on a local disk. It supports Hermes and provides a Python SDK for LangChain and llama.cpp.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer provides portable identity, memory, and secrets for Hermes Agent and other clients like Claude Code and Codex. It includes tools to inspect, edit, and repair memory, alongside a dashboard for retrieval inspection.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: A local-first context engine that utilizes hybrid retrieval with BM25 and vector search. It integrates via MCP and Claude Code hooks, using a local GGUF observer model to capture decisions.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency and token usage through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based memory system using SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is distributed as a five-package plugin family including an MCP server and a Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval via 'why_retrieved' tags and tracks contradictions using conflict and resolution primitives. It supports both embedded in-process mode and an HTTP backend for clusters.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp and functions as an MCP-native server.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets per query.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system featuring semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It provides automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support and bidirectional edge tags.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens before the context window opens. It implements the Model Context Protocol and offers encrypted persistent memory via the Perseus Vault.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: A daemonless memory system that stores information as inspectable Markdown files. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single.lbdb embedded graph database and BM25-first retrieval. It features importance-weighted recall and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory with immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It includes a trace.jsonl audit log to track every memory operation and prefetch operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session AI memory through semantic search. It mirrors native Hermes memory writes to XMemo and supports session snapshots and working state storage.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates directly with Hermes to facilitate automated payments.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It offers tools for manual memory storage, searching, and configurable query expansion with result reranking.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This reusable plugin provides tools for searching, fetching, and traversing local artifact graphs. It features automatic generation of tool-routing knowledge via OKFs and supports proactive routing through an installable skill.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, running locally over localhost. It supports semantic and literal code search alongside grounded Q&A featuring file-and-line citations.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native long-term memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall. It includes MinHash for near-duplicate detection and supports metadata/range filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides an agentic software development methodology that enforces a red-green-refactor TDD cycle. It utilizes subagents for two-stage reviews of implementation plans and integrates with coding harnesses like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first design and prototyping system includes a CLI for coding agents and an MCP server for integration. It manages design systems via DESIGN.md and supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills across 29 security domains. These skills are mapped to six major frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST AI RMF, and are compatible with Hermes Agent.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of draw.io diagrams from natural language descriptions using 11 diagram type presets. It converts Mermaid text into editable files and features self-check and auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using 57 pattern categories and a 111-entry word replacement table. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Cursor.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project facilitates collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an Agentic Evolver. It provides automated skill deduplication and quality improvement to maintain unified skill libraries across multiple agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library is compatible with agentskills.io-compatible agents and Claude Code. It includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys and supports installation via skills.sh.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides adjudication, escrow, and dispute resolution. It utilizes natural-language mandates and ERC-7710 delegated permissions through a master router and connector skills.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, offering slash commands to manage and save detected patterns.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This set of skills allows for video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI using modular packages of instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This plugin teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts through the dynamic generation of custom lenses. It features seven pre-built prisms and provides constraint reporting to identify analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full modes. It includes a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models to ensure quality during the transition from idea to handoff.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro serves as a harness for long-running AI agents using a three-level work model. It supports file-backed and SQLite-backed cards and provides a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the literate document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory via markdown files and automates the capture of high-value decisions. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills provide integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the Agent Skills specification. They include specialized skills for CRE and ACE services to enable oracle network and smart contract interaction.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, and error handling, alongside support for JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files by converting repositories, documentation, or developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides provenance through documentation URLs or file:line citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io is a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features via TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, complex multi-step tasks. It features real-time tracking of decisions and progress, along with built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This skill implements a progressive MCP client using a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a workflow language that uses a single Rust binary to process intent as code. It features static auditing for types, permissions, and cost, and produces hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill manages files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a 5-layer intelligent skill retrieval system using hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and features graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This tool performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It utilizes a deterministic pre-scan layer and an MCP server to generate suppression rules for reducing false positives.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to specific model families and preserves non-English prompts using langid or Unicode-range heuristics.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io integrates with MCP and Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill employs a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness through a risk-tiered triage system. It includes language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures to implement multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub enables community skill browsing, searching, and one-click installation via the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates structured Chinese news briefings across multiple geographic scales, from global to street level. It produces reports with core conclusions and action suggestions while integrating user interests via semantic memory.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are updated automatically on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This is a zero-install desktop GUI for Windows that requires no admin rights. It features an integrated workflow engine for automated multi-step pipelines and includes a toolset with TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project provides an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports configurable gateway mode.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project sandboxes Hermes Agent using hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access through configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane allows for the deployment, monitoring, and operation of OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities, hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework decomposes financial trading tasks into specialized roles, such as fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It supports multiple LLM providers and local Ollama models to manage multi-agent workflows.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend. It supports various frameworks including CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini. It offers optional sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template utilizes a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This control room template uses a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for orchestrator-to-specialist delegation. It provides bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms with durable agent memory and MCP tool integration. It supports over 23 LLM providers and provides visual org charts for agent team delegation.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous task status and review queues. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This framework coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for local tool and communication handling, featuring a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents competing as two different AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for visualizing tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This tool routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code using ACP-style delegation. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and output character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It functions as an MCP server supporting TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, and C# with automatic project indexing and synchronization.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This cross-platform CLI tool features a native Rust TUI for tracking token usage. It monitors multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, and Gemini.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows for the inspection of coding-agent API traffic from Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, and OpenCode. It provides exportable HTML trace sessions and redacts common auth headers before recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate apps with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows and supports autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This CLI tool provides community-driven skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners using YAML-based configuration.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents through encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce via Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without OAuth or separate processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training, GGUF inference, and vLLM.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible browser UI for real-time AI supervision and includes session management and an integrated research desk.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance and offers automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder scoping. It allows for seamless switching between scoped and default agents while supporting custom instructions, tools, and project-local memories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: This static linter validates AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts using regex and structural heuristics. It supports JSON, YAML, plain text, Markdown, and.prompt files without requiring model or API calls, and includes HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool facilitates the transition from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by moving SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives. It maps existing configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides self-healing capabilities for multi-agent systems through automated operational and functional health monitoring. It includes a beta Hermes plugin to export telemetry for API requests and tool calls, alongside token intelligence tracking for cost estimation and memory bloat.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing multiple agentic tools and CLI models, including Hermes Agent.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork application that supports various agent CLIs like Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It features built-in assistants for Word, Excel, and PPT, and offers remote access via WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram and WeChat.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript web interface designed for use on browsers or mobile phones. It provides a three-panel layout featuring chat and workspace file browsing with full parity to the Hermes CLI experience.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to assist with the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A web dashboard that includes a file browser, web terminal, and usage analytics. It supports multi-platform AI chat, scheduled jobs, and unified configuration for channels such as Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a Monaco editor, PTY terminal, and integrated memory browser. It supports Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that enables direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes embedded terminal access and native views for Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows and macOS desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime and supports Markdown and LaTeX rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium that connects active browser contexts to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It includes Hermes Web for full-page workspace sessions.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard that provides real-time chat with tool call visualization and an MCP server control plane. It includes a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit and session browser that supports Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It provides live per-session quota burn-rate tracking and operates locally with no telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace specifically for Hermes Agent running on SSH hosts or Orgo cloud computers. It features one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An OpenTUI-based terminal dashboard that consolidates Hermes Agent chat, sessions, and configuration. It features integrated kanban boards for task and diagnostic management alongside an extensible Eikon avatar system.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. This interface supports streaming chat with file attachments and allows for the background spawning of up to five concurrent agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A no-install Windows desktop distribution that operates without Docker or admin rights. It includes a GUI, 100 tools such as ComfyUI and TTS, and a workflow engine for scheduled multi-step automation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A self-hosted glassmorphic web interface providing real-time log streaming and chat. The UI includes a dedicated file browser, task tracking dashboard, and management tools for MCP servers, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring and configuration dashboard focused on session activity and cost tracking. It enables full inspection of skill source code and conversation histories, with read-only access to environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring a chat-first interface with tool approval cards and SSE streaming. It provides isolated profile management for API keys and memory, plus a marketplace for installing MCP servers and skills.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching via a streaming SSE interface.
